body:
**Hands-on check on macOS, release build of this branch (Setups page → "Lay on a plane").**

- **`cube_inside_out.stl`:** pick the top face with G17. Apply is greyed out. Its tooltip reads "…belongs to a body whose facets are inside-out (wound inward), so its outside would be read backwards - fix the model's facet winding (re-export it) before aligning to it". The "outside:" line is absent.
- **A normal part (the simple2 plate):** the same pick with G17 gives an active Apply ("Turn the part so the pick lies on G17 (XY)") and the line "outside: +Z in the model of face …".

The 3-2-1 "Align WCS" path was not exercised by hand. It is pinned in `winding_align`.

**Gate:** upstream/main merged (clean), then `scripts/gate.sh quick`. `winding_align` passes 9/9. The remaining reds also fail on upstream main:
- `swarf_pose_continuity`, fixed by #351;
- the GPU headless tests.
